description:
Start a purchase with the chosen payment option.

did_registration: returns a payable quote (the same as
debitmydata_create_did_payment_quote).

Add-ons for a DID-LLM (bottybotty_entry, bottybotty_standard, bottybotty_premium): returns
a payable quote for details.did; for a higher BottyBotty tier than the one owned, it
charges the difference.
Pay it, wait for debitmydata_get_payment_status to say "settled", then
debitmydata_complete_purchase.

Donations (inference_donation, USDC on Base through x402): call with the amount; it
fails with the x402 payment requirements. Sign them with your wallet and call again
with the same details and x402_payment. The answer is the donation with a receipt
signed by DebitMyData, or its status_url while the payment confirms. Sending the same
payment again returns the same donation.

details.description: Product-specific fields. For did_registration: display_name, participant_type, controller_public_key and/or controller_wallet_address (with optional controller_network), and optionally metadata. For a donation (inference_donation): amount_usd, and optionally donor_name and donor_did. For an add-on (such as bottybotty_entry): did, the DID-LLM it is for
details.title: Details

idempotency_key.description: did_registration only: optional random key (16-128 characters) for safe retries
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

x402_payment.description: Donations only: your signed PaymentPayload (x402 version 2) answering the payment requirements this tool returned. It may also be sent in the request's _meta['x402/payment'].
x402_payment.title: X402 Payment
